blogs.title: My Journey Creating a Personal Webpage with AI Tools
blogs.author: Vidya Venkappa
blogs.excerpt: Discover how I leveraged cutting-edge AI tools to design and develop my personal website. This journey explores the intersection of traditional web development and AI assistance, highlighting both the capabilities and limitations of today's generative design tools.

blogs.title: Microsoft Digital Defense Report Analysis
blogs.author: Vidya Venkappa
blogs.excerpt: An in-depth analysis of Microsoft's Digital Defense Reports using a custom Retrieval-Augmented Generation pipeline. Learn how I combined ChromaDB, LangChain, and Microsoft's Phi-3.5 model to extract actionable security insights from years of threat intelligence data.

blogs.title: Navigating the AI Research Tool Landscape: A Critical Reflection
blogs.author: Vidya Venkappa
blogs.excerpt: A comprehensive analysis of today's leading AI research assistants based on my hands-on testing. I evaluate how these tools handle complex research queries, compare their accuracy, source attribution, and reasoning capabilities, and provide practical guidance for choosing the right AI research companion for different academic and professional needs.

blogs.title: Predicting Security Incidents in Microsoft Systems
blogs.author: Vidya Venkappa
blogs.excerpt: How I built an 80% accurate machine learning model to predict security incidents in Microsoft systems using the GUIDE dataset. This project demonstrates the power of CatBoost for classification and reveals critical patterns in cybersecurity threats across Windows and Linux environments.

blogs.title: Balancing Act: Navigating Education & Career
blogs.author: Vidya Venkappa
blogs.excerpt: Navigating two worlds: completing a Master's at India's top university while working as a Software Engineer at Cisco, versus being a full-time student at UW Foster. My personal reflections on the challenges, benefits, and lessons learned from both educational paths.
